# Conquering `curl error 28`: A Senior Developer's Guide to Composer Failures in Laravel Projects

As developers, we often find ourselves hitting frustrating roadblocks when setting up new projects or updating dependencies. One of the most common and maddening errors encountered during this process is `curl error 28`. This error, which usually manifests as an operation timeout, stops Composer from successfully downloading packages from repositories like Packagist or GitHub.
